builds.name: Void Rush ceiling
builds.summary: Void Rush has 350+1 AD[statFormula=2]+25% target max HP in current source. Do not substitute historical missing-health scaling.
builds.goal: Void Rush has 350+1 AD[statFormula=2]+25% target max HP in current source. Do not substitute historical missing-health scaling.
builds.hypothesis:
Rek'Sai targets an enemy damaged by her in the last [5] seconds and then dives underground, becoming Untargetable. Moments later, she leaps unstoppably at her target, dealing [150 / 250 / 350 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2]] plus [15 / 20 / 25]% max Health physical damage and resets the cooldown of {{Spell_RekSaiW_Name}}.
Bloodthirster/Infinity Edge/Eclipse provide high AD; Grudge supplies armor penetration; Profane/Youmuu supply AD and lethality. Infinity Edge crit is not assumed to multiply this spell. First Strike adds a separately measured initiation bonus; Absolute Focus supplies adaptive stat only above its health threshold; Gathering Storm is fixed to 30min. Cash Back/Biscuit/Cosmic are economy/sustain/utility, not assumed direct damage multipliers.

Tag target for eligibility, then reset target HP and isolate R at fixed max HP. Log raw kit packet(s), post-mitigation damage and separate item/rune packets; repeat at 100% target HP and swap one item at a time. First Strike must be ready and champion initiates; compare eligible bonus separately.

Isolate the named ability/passive packet from item procs, rune damage and the rest of the combo. Record raw versus post-resistance damage, actual crit outcome, charge, rank and target state. Healing/shield/execute thresholds are separate metrics, not damage.

tradeoffs: Six completed items assume late boots sell/swap; movement and practical survival/access are sacrificed for the number. Bloodthirster, Infinity Edge, Serylda's Grudge, Profane Hydra, Youmuu's Ghostblade, Eclipse. Required setup damage is excluded from scored ability. Defensive or attack-speed replacements may win real fights despite a lower isolated packet.
Confidence: speculative. This is a finite-condition ceiling candidate, not a solver-certified global maximum or a recommended match build.

builds.summary: Explore a large maximum-Fury Furious Bite number under fixed conditions, comparing legal item swaps rather than assuming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Explore a large maximum-Fury Furious Bite number under fixed conditions, comparing legal item swaps rather than assuming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: The current extracted empowered E helper is (170 + 0.6 bonus AD) times 1.2 at rank 5, delivered as true damage at maximum Fury. AD is the direct scaling; armor penetration cannot improve this true packet. Shadowflame is a deliberately unusual slot: its source description includes low-health true-damage amplification, which may outweigh one more AD item despite AP not scaling the bite.
